title: Judge a committed example's validity window by the instant it declares, not by the wall clock

looked_in: every dated string in contracts/examples/**/*.json and *.jsonl at 2026-10-17T01:15Z: three valid_until fields, all 2026-10-17T00:00:00Z (scope_approval.json and two rejected fixtures, both voided), and no other validity date later than now
every scope_approval card in the tree outside the imported autofocus subtree: the same three, none in an agent's approvals/
contracts/validate.py for datetime.now, utcnow, time.time and date.today: one use, check 19
the 2026-10-15 check 88 fixture fix, f2897ea5, the same class driven by a commit instead of the clock

changes.change: Check 19, for cards under contracts/examples/ only, including the rejected fixtures: compare valid_until with the instant the card itself declares as its 'now'. The building seat names the field; approved_at is the fallback when it is absent, so every existing example is judged at the moment it describes. Everywhere else, which today means a real scope_approval in an agent's approvals/, check 19 keeps the wall clock exactly as now.

If a new field carries the declared instant, it is optional, documented as meaningful only under contracts/examples/, and a real card carrying it is refused, so a live permit cannot use it to stop its own clock.

Once the check change is in, the void added on 2026-10-17 can be taken back, so the one valid example is again a live permit and check 19's 'live and within caps' path is exercised by a committed card. Whether to do that is the building seat's call.

An expired-not-voided fixture declares an instant after its valid_until, so it stays rejected forever whatever the date. Plus one fixture, rejected, for a real-path card that carries the declared-instant field.

notes: The person chose this over a warning with a horizon, in this seat's window on 2026-10-17 (UTC), after both were put to them in plain words. It is a loosening under 8.3 rule 1: check 19's expiry refusal is lifted for examples judged at an instant they declare. Rule 1 asks that the person's word be said in the owner seat's window. This one was said in the harness seat's window, so the person has been asked to say it again in the window of the seat that lands this. That seat should not land it on this quote alone. What it removes is the class's time half, for examples: no committed example can go red on its own. It does not touch real permits, whose clock is the point of check 19. It does not touch the commit-driven half either, which f2897ea5 closed for envelopes. A sweep for other live inputs a fixture's verdict can read, such as the store version or the seat registry, is still open. The void the building seat added today is the right fix for today, because it opens the gate at once, and this proposal does not compete with it. On 2026-10-17, told that the word must be said in the owner seat's window, the person said in this seat's window: "너가 직접 전달해" (you deliver it directly). This seat relayed both quotes to manager-microscope-office-20261016-1 and left to that seat whether a relayed word, given at the person's own instruction, meets rule 1. Landed at a56c49df on the person's word said in the owner seat's window, quoted above. The field is example_judged_at; without it an example is judged at its approved_at.
